name: Snails stir-fried with coconut
summary: Ốc xào dừa is snails fried with soy sauce, lemongrass, tamarind sauce, and coconut. The common kinds are ốc điếu, ốc mút, and ốc bươu.
howToEat: Fried with nước tương, sả, sốt me, and dừa. VnExpress names ốc điếu, ốc mút, and ốc bươu. Báo Quảng Ninh, 9 Jul 2015, also says ốc are boiled, or stir-fried with chili sauce and the juice of quất. Both methods stay.
VnExpress printed about 35,000 đồng a plate, depending on the snail.
where: VnExpress, 16 Mar 2021, names the alley beside the old Quảng Ninh Museum on Nguyễn Văn Cừ, and the Văn Lang sidewalk.
Báo Quảng Ninh, 6 May 2020, names phố Bùi Thị Xuân in phường Hồng Hải for cooked snails. That ward name is the article’s.
seoTitle: Oc xao dua — Ha Long snails with coconut
seoDescription: Ốc xào dừa is snails fried with soy, lemongrass, tamarind, and coconut.
